verdict.rationale: SolidJS explicitly advertises being 'Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere' (solid-gh-6), directly matching the story, and this is reinforced by isomorphic/SSR support claims (solid-gh-13, solid-gh-4). However, there's no independent/community corroboration of custom renderer usage for non-DOM targets, nor detail on the API (e.g. solid-js/universal) or examples of real non-DOM targets shipped. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of a non-DOM renderer in production, documentation of the universal renderer API, community validation of this specific capability.
